classes.title: Premium precision exceeds a two-decimal target
classes.causing_condition: Feed and fact premiums use NUMBER(14,4). A fixed random seed produces nonzero third and fourth decimal places; mapping premiums to NUMBER(12,2) changes their values.
classes.surfaces_in: Type mapping and premium reconciliation at source precision

classes.title: Empty agent strings become Oracle NULLs
classes.causing_condition: Every seventeenth policy sends an empty agent code. Oracle stores the empty string as NULL and the loader preserves the NULL in the policy dimension and fact. A target retaining empty strings changes NULL counts and join behavior.
classes.surfaces_in: Agent NULL profiling and target join parity

classes.title: Rate resolution depends on the Oracle DATE time component
classes.causing_condition: Policy transactions occur at 14:30 on the rate change day. The lookup uses strict eff_dt < transaction time, selecting 0.12. Truncating the transaction to midnight before the same lookup selects the previous 0.10 rate.
classes.surfaces_in: Effective-date boundary characterization and rate reconciliation

classes.title: Payment delivery repeats claim and payment sequence keys
classes.causing_condition: The initial delivery repeats eight keys. ROW_NUMBER selects the latest load_ts per claim and payment sequence before MERGE. Removing the selection either creates unstable MERGE inputs or overstates aggregates. The November delivery adds a source column and ten more duplicate payment rows.
classes.surfaces_in: Payment key profiling, MERGE translation and overnight schema drift

classes.title: Agent-level rounding survives portfolio reconciliation
classes.causing_condition: The loader rounds each 33.33/33.33/33.34 percent agent share to cents before summing. Paired 1.00 and 1.01 amounts offset their rounding differences at portfolio level, while individual policy distributions differ by a cent from a total-first allocation. Comparing portfolio totals alone misses the differences.
classes.surfaces_in: Per-policy and per-agent reconciliation despite matching portfolio totals

classes.title: Scheduled territory snapshot has no consumer
classes.causing_condition: The weekly agent territory job writes agent_territory_snapshot. The output table has no reader in ETL, services, report SQL or frontend code; only the writer references the table.
classes.surfaces_in: Schedule inventory and downstream lineage discovery

classes.title: Warehouse codes need interpretation outside the database
classes.causing_condition: CLM_FLG_3 and POL_CD_X have no column comments. CLM_STATUS is restricted to integers 1 through 7 with no database lookup table or labels. The only status-to-label mapping lives in the React claim screen.
classes.surfaces_in: Business glossary discovery and frontend-to-warehouse lineage

classes.title: Lapsed policies exclude commission reversal rows
classes.causing_condition: Some policies carry both LAPSED status and a REVERSAL entry. The loader's eligibility predicate excludes these rows, while loading reversals for active policies. A migration preserving source reversals rather than the legacy filter changes warehouse totals; business review must decide the future rule.
classes.surfaces_in: Reversal coverage, reconciliation and business-owner review

discovery_extras.title: External agent codes have no agent dimension match
discovery_extras.causing_condition: Six EXT-prefixed agent codes occur in feed_policy, dim_policy and fact_policy but have no DIM_AGENT row. Ordinary assigned codes match the existing AG-100 through AG-105 agents; every seventeenth row remains unassigned.
discovery_extras.surfaces_in: Referential integrity profiling and unmatched-agent joins

discovery_extras.title: Claim delivery contains placeholder and out-of-order dates
discovery_extras.causing_condition: Three claims have a 1900-01-01 loss date and three have a loss date after their report date. Source dates are retained in feed_claim rather than rejected or normalized.
discovery_extras.surfaces_in: Date profiling and source-quality acceptance rules

discovery_extras.title: Daily and weekly jobs rebuild the same claims payment summary
discovery_extras.causing_condition: The daily job groups joined payment rows by policy code. The weekly job first aggregates by claim, then groups by policy code. Both rebuild all-history counts and totals, and the report reads both output tables. The equivalent business process can be consolidated into one model.
discovery_extras.surfaces_in: Schedule comparison, SQL lineage and model consolidation
